data: Which of the languages have the highest emergence value for the smallest text length?

The question asks which language has the highest emergence value for the smallest text length. From the caption, we know that the vertical axis represents dimensionless values ranging from 0 to 1. The leftmost graph shows the emergence values for English, Spanish, and Artificial languages across different text lengths. 

Looking at the leftmost graph, we can see that the emergence values for all three languages decrease as the text length increases. At the smallest text length (approximately 0.02 thousand words), the emergence values for all three languages are relatively high. However, the English line is positioned above the Spanish and Artificial lines at this point. Therefore, English has the highest emergence value for the smallest text length.
